description: Replaces Rack's module browser with one that builds and stores every module's preview picture ahead of time, so scrolling the browser does not stall
notes: the module has no jacks and no knobs; placing it in the rack is the whole of using it, and taking it out puts the ordinary browser back
the pictures are kept on disk under Leviathan/Deepcache in the Rack user folder and survive restarts, so the long first build happens once
the lamps report what the caching is doing and the bar below them fills as it goes; they cannot be clicked
a second copy of this module does nothing, and it stands aside entirely if another plugin has already replaced the browser, saying so on its menu
menu: Rebuild cache — throws away every stored preview and builds them all again
Cache resolution — picks whether previews are stored at normal size or at double, which is sharper when browser cards are enlarged and takes about four times the memory
UI work budget: 0.5 ms, 1 ms, 2 ms, 4 ms, 8 ms — sets how long each drawn frame may spend building previews, trading a faster build for a smoother window
Cache statistics — reports how many previews are done, how many failed, how much memory they take and how long each one took to build
